summary: Senior full-stack engineer with **13+ years** delivering scalable enterprise platforms (ERP/POS/QMS) and automation systems. Strong in **React + TypeScript** frontends and **Node.js** backends, building modular UI, REST APIs, and real-time workflows. Experienced integrating practical AI features (OpenAI/LangChain, YOLO) and running production deployments with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. ---

experience.description: Architected **IdolMEA ERP** integrating **POS, QMS, and AI vision** modules. Built multi-branch dashboards and services using **Node.js** with secure site connectivity. Developed **AI theft detection** (YOLO) for **self-checkout kiosks**. Designed secure API routing and microservices architecture. Integrated **WhatsApp/Telegram chat automation** for live queue alerts and service updates. Created **hybrid cloud sync engine** (MySQL ↔ Hive) enabling offline analytics and recovery.

Designed and deployed **SincA ERP**, combining Flutter, Node.js, and AI analytics in Python. Built dashboards, OCR systems, and predictive models using OpenAI and TensorFlow. Dockerized microservices across local + cloud sync nodes with CI/CD pipelines. Mentored distributed teams across India and UAE in architecture, DevOps, and clean design.
Developed enterprise ERP and billing systems using **WPF (C#)** and **PHP/MySQL**. Improved UI responsiveness, caching, and modularization for accounting/reporting modules.
